body:
## Why

Maint 71 cannot advance generated dev-tool PRs when an active CodeRabbit thread survives a refreshed head, even when checks pass. Its normal review request is after the review-blocked exit and selects Codex rather than the originating reviewer. Generated PR comments and thread disposition must remain source-owned.

## Scope

Add a narrowly scoped Maint 71 reassessment operation for one exact-head generated dev-tool PR and active thread. Bind the request to repository, PR number, full head SHA, thread ID, delivery plan, generation, source commit, and originating reviewer. Use the configured reviewer command, durable request evidence, and idempotency. Continue to refuse merging until the reviewer explicitly disposes of the finding and all normal gates pass.

## Non-Goals

- Do not treat project Python minimum alone as proof of every tool interpreter.
- Do not fabricate a source-fix SHA, broaden managed-file auto-resolution to dev-tool files, or self-resolve CodeRabbit threads.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add an exact-head reviewer-reassessment handler to .github/scripts/maint71_merge_sync_prs.js reachable while a generated dev-tool PR is review-blocked.
- [ ] Add one explicit trusted dispatch input in .github/workflows/maint-71-merge-sync-prs.yml for the named PR and thread.
- [ ] Update .github/scripts/maint71_merge_sync_prs.js to read config/consumer_sync_review_policy.json, select the originating reviewer and command, and persist request URL, time, and head with duplicate-request protection.
- [ ] Add cases in .github/scripts/__tests__/maint71_merge_sync_prs.test.js for stale heads, wrong threads, duplicate requests, ambiguous POST, nonresponse, and active-thread merge refusal.
- [ ] Update docs/ops/CONSUMER_REPO_MAINTENANCE.md with the operator route.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/maint71_merge_sync_prs.test.js passes for a single source-owned exact-head CodeRabbit reassessment request and a deduplicated replay.
- [ ] Head, plan, thread, or reviewer changes invalidate a prior request binding; active non-outdated threads still block merge.
- [ ] A reviewer-cleared exact head proceeds only after required checks, mergeability, and the seven-minute review floor, without invented source-fix proof.
